text: Summary from the report (March 17, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO: This report includes an outline of the performance objectives of the Chief Executive Officer for 2022 and compensation and HR matters.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Referred the item to the Chief Executive Officer to review and revise the annual objectives for 2022 based on the feedback from members in closed session, and report back to the Board at its May 17, 2022 meeting.
